query: FROM ext-logs-cloudflare | EVAL `start_time` = TO_DATETIME(EdgeStartTimestamp / 1000000), `end_time` = TO_DATETIME(EdgeEndTimestamp / 1000000) | USER_AGENT useragent = ClientRequestUserAgent | IP_LOCATION clientip = ClientIP | WHERE useragent.os.name IS NOT NULL AND clientip.country_iso_code IS NOT NULL
